summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Goldman Sachs Real Estate Finance Trust Inc reporting the sale of unregistered shares under an ongoing private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, monthly distribution declarations, and two new loan originations. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or management change. The filing describes ordinary capital-raising and operational activities typical for a REIT, without any event that would alter the corporate structure, control, or strategy.
